# tomswallapi_blrule (Resource)

A blacklist/whitelist rule, processed before normal rules.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tomswallapi_blrule" "block_scanner" {
  action = "drop"
  source = "net:203.0.113.66"
  log    = "info"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) drop, reject, whitelist, ...

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Free-form comment.
- `dest` (String) Destination to match (zone, interface, or address in shorewall notation).
- `dport` (List of String) Destination ports or port ranges to match.
- `log` (String) Log level for matching packets (e.g. info).
- `priority` (Number) Evaluation priority; lower first.
- `proto` (String) Protocol to match (tcp, udp, icmp, ...).
- `source` (String) Source to match (zone, interface, or address in shorewall notation).
- `sport` (List of String) Source ports or port ranges to match.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the server-assigned numeric id.
terraform import tomswallapi_blrule.block_scanner 42
```
